rust_summary: a server player's client sent new client information (`native_client_information_updated`).
doc_summary: `native_client_information_updated(player, name, old, new)`, when a server player's client sends `ServerboundClientInformationPacket` in play: language, view distance, chat visibility and colours, skin parts, main hand, text filtering, server listing and particle status. `old` and `new` are `NativeClientInfo` values (`old` is the stored information before, `new` the one just stored); they can be equal. It fires after the new information is stored. Listen-only; configuration-phase packets are not reported (the player does not exist yet). Server-side. Bundles need "hooks": @API:client_information_updated@.
